beats.summary: Roy attacks Jim, but Dwight intervenes by using pepper spray to stop him.
Dwight explains he has carried pepper spray for eight years to protect employees and feels vindicated after using it.

evidence.snippet: Everyday, for eight years, I have brought pepper spray into this office to protect myself and my fellow employees.

beats.summary: Roy is fired and Jim chooses not to press charges; Darryl uses the incident to leverage a raise.

evidence.snippet: Well, we fired Roy, obviously. And Jim won't press charges against Roy or the company.

beats.summary: Jim thanks Dwight for stopping Roy and offers him a gift, which Dwight refuses.

evidence.snippet: Hey man, I never got a chance to thank you… for stopping Roy. Thank you.
